verdict.rationale: Alloy's own docs say its transaction-monitoring workflows 'generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met' (alloy-docs-17), and the marketing site claims a single view of fraud risk across onboarding, transactions, and account activity (alloy-docs-19). This is a thin, glancing mention: nothing shows an analyst prioritizing alerts or grouping subjects and transactions into an investigation. Missing for 10: alert prioritization/scoring and queueing, analyst-driven grouping of related subjects and transactions into a case, investigation workspace documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
